findings: Windows ENOSPC injection at result.json writes a failed run receipt; ENOSPC at final run.json persistence propagates and leaves the prior preparing state rather than a false success.
The process identity code records start-time identity for Windows/Linux and on macOS prefers proc_pidinfo microsecond start fields with a ps lstart fallback and explicit source precision.
Windows-hosted unit tests exercise the macOS proc_pidinfo structure and selection/fallback behavior, but they mock the macOS API and are not a native macOS check.
limitations: Linux and native macOS process/status acceptance remain outstanding; targeted Linux /proc and macOS proc_pidinfo/ps-fallback runners are configured but have not yet produced evidence.
Native macOS proc_pidinfo timestamp behavior and actual fallback precision have not been verified on macOS.
